name: Broccoli Chicken Divan
desc: Broccoli and cooked chicken baked under a creamy soup sauce, Cheddar, and buttered crumbs.

source.title: Chicken Broccoli Divan
source.evidence: Same build and pan: broccoli and cooked chicken in a 9-inch pie plate, condensed soup thinned with milk, Cheddar, and buttered bread crumbs; Campbell's current version uses cream of chicken soup at 400°F.

ingredients.raw: 1 (10.75 oz) can condensed cream of broccoli soup

steps: Put the broccoli in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 5 minutes, then drain well.
Spread the broccoli in a 9-inch pie plate and top with the chicken.
Stir the soup and milk together in a bowl and pour over the chicken. Sprinkle with the Cheddar.
Stir the melted butter into the bread crumbs and scatter over the cheese.
Bake 15-20 minutes, until bubbling at the edges and browned on top.
tips: Campbell's current version of this recipe uses cream of chicken soup and bakes at 400°F for 20 minutes; either soup works.
